cross_verification.note_en: No operational, verifiable official Syrian visa-photo specification could be located. Syria's dedicated e-visa portal (evisa.sy) failed to load with a certificate error and third-party search results describe it as showing 'Coming Soon'. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates services page (mofaex.gov.sy/en/services) was checked directly and lists 28 consular services for Syrians abroad but no visa-issuance service for foreign visitors. A site calling itself 'syriaembassy.org' surfaced in search results claiming embassy status, but was confirmed via further search to be a private third-party document-legalization service, not the genuine Syrian government embassy site, so any data from it is excluded entirely per the truthfulness policy. Note: post-transitional-government Syria (2025-2026) entry is largely visa-on-arrival at Damascus/Aleppo airports and the Lebanese land border with prior online entry approval, which may explain the absence of a conventional visa photo-upload specification.
